written: 2026-11-23, before any exercise of the second pilot was written
why: The first pilot's 277 operators changed no real task (0 of 434). Its exercise teacher read 'do not reproduce benchmark tasks' as 'avoid every topic a benchmark uses' and left out the classic textbook exercises, which is where invented and real tasks would overlap; its exercises were also harder than real ones (the engine solved 7% of them against 74% of real tasks). The user chose to run a second pilot that separates a classic concept, general knowledge, from a benchmark item's wording, examples and constants
stage_1: one teacher invents 300 mostly introductory exercises, classic topics welcome (docs/round5_task_guide2.md); the same decontamination as the first pilot (against evaluation tasks and the 434 training-side real tasks)
stage_2: the shipped engine on the kept exercises; failures form the bank (scripts/round5_bank.py --parts 2)
stage_3: one operator teacher writes the pack r5_pilot2 (operator names prefixed r52_) for that bank with the round-5 operator guide, seeing neither real tasks nor the first pilot's pack
primary_measure: the 434 training-side real tasks: newly solved minus broken under the strict judge, the shipped engine plus r5_pilot2 against the shipped engine. Supported if at least 5; not supported if at most 1; inconclusive otherwise
secondary_measures: the same under the lenient judge
only if supported: the development fifth once, both judges, the main system with the pack against 69 and 58
not_tuned_on: the 434 training-side real tasks (measured once, after the pack is frozen)

outcome.primary: 434 training-side real tasks with the shipped engine plus r5_pilot2 (1,146 operators): 5 first programs changed; strict newly solved 1, broken 1, net 0: not supported (reports/seedlm/round5_pilot2_transfer.json). The development fifth was not measured, as registered
secondary: the pack's own bank: 160 of 168 invented exercises newly solved, none of the 119 solved ones broken (reports/seedlm/round5_pilot2_teacher_report.json)

reading the 5 changed tasks (exploration, training data): one new solve (password validity, nothing found before), one break under the strict judge (largest product of adjacent elements became the largest product of any two after sorting, which passes the three asserts by coincidence), three equivalent rewrites of programs that were already right; a pack gate opens on 100 of the 434 descriptions
outcome.reading: With classic concepts allowed and introductory difficulty, the invented exercises sit much closer to real ones (the engine solves 41% of them, against 7% in the first pilot and 74% of real tasks) and the pack's gates open on a quarter of real descriptions; but the real tasks those concepts describe are already solved by the shipped library, so the new operators only rewrite them, once wrongly. The knowledge that would help is in the failures, and failures are idiosyncratic
